descriptor: Calm email inbox for people who hate email

voice.summary: Drift talks like someone who has quietly given up on inbox zero and found peace: soft, funny and never urgent. It promises calm and keeps its own emails short.
dos: Be honest about the launch date and queue position
Use a little self-deprecating humour about email
donts: Never send more than one update a week

taglines: Calm email for people who hate email
boilerplate: Drift is a calm email client for people who hate email, launching soon with a waitlist that rewards referrals with earlier access and extra features.

microcopy.success: You are #1,284 in line. Share to move up.
microcopy.error: That email does not look right. Try again.
microcopy.empty: No friends invited yet. Share your link to climb.

logo.note: A soft cloud suggests drifting and a quieter, lighter inbox.
